title: Night's Piercing Thorn
next_chapter_hook: Three corpses lay ice-cold, yet fragments of the assassins' fate still echoed within the Tianji Record—and that name made Chen Ji's pupils dilate. The underground altar of the Imperial Capital, cloaked black figures, and a name that should never appear in this era: Ling Yuan.

text.content:
Midnight.

The moon hid behind clouds, and the quarters of the Tianqing Sect's Observer were shrouded in deathly silence. The changing of the guards outside the quarters had passed a quarter ago, the footsteps of patrols fading into the distance. The entire courtyard seemed forgotten between heaven and earth.

Three black shadows glided along the wall bases like specters, crossing the corridors without a sound. Their movements were eerily precise, each step carefully avoiding the patterns on the stone slabs—those were the unique sensing formations of the Tianqing Sect, and ordinary people triggering them would set off alarms.

But these three were no ordinary people.

Clad in night-combat attire, the tokens hanging at their waists flashed briefly in the moonlight. On the back of each token, a jet-black Xuanwu raised its head in a snarl, its fangs bared.

dialogue.content: (In a low, commanding voice) The target's quarters are just ahead. Remember—we don't need living witnesses, but the Tianji Record Fragment must be brought back.

text.content:
Inside the quarters, the candlelight flickered.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a cushion, dressed in plain white sleeping robes, his appearance withered and haggard—a perfect picture of someone whose body had been hollowed out by wine and pleasure. In his hands, he held a yellowed ancient scroll, dozing with half-closed eyes, even a strand of drool hanging from the corner of his mouth.

Nowhere could one see that this was the legendary figure who commanded the Observer of the Tianqing Sect.

However, beside him, behind a folding screen, a slender figure stood silently. Chen Nian wore night-combat attire, her face covered by a light veil, her eyes hiding sharp glints. Her fingers brushed gently against an antique jade pendant at her waist—the "Soul-Binding Pendant" passed down through the Chen family's ancestors.

dialogue.content: (Softly) Brother, they're here. Three people, Golden Core Peak stage, and they carry... the aura of the Xuanwu Sect.
(Still squinting, lips barely moving) Mm... got it. Let them in, I'll keep pretending to sleep.
(Frowning slightly) Aren't you afraid? Three Golden Core cultivators...
(Rolling over, yawning) With you here, what should I be afraid of? Go on, remember—don't reveal too much strength. Let them think my useless sister has finally come in handy.

text.content:
The words had barely fallen when the window lattice rattled softly.

Three black shadows burst through the window like phantoms, bringing with them a gust of cold, yin energy. The candlelight swayed violently, nearly extinguishing. The lead assassin held a jet-black short blade, its blade surface flowing with eerie patterns—those were "Soul-Devouring Stabs," specifically designed to suppress spiritual consciousness.

Chen Nian stood in front of Chen Ji, her diminutive figure trembling slightly—a perfect performance. Her legs trembled as she spoke in a shaky voice: "You... who are you!"

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) Waste pairs with waste, quite the perfect match. Where's the Tianji Record? Hand it over obediently and I'll give you a quick death.

text.content:
Behind the folding screen, Chen Ji still maintained his drowsy appearance, but his divine consciousness had already sunk into the yellowed scroll in his embrace. On the cover of the Tianji Record, a vertical eye opened quietly, and ancient patterns began to flow.

【Heavenly Fate Value Consumed: 5 points】
【Current Heavenly Fate Value: 72/100】

He saw it.

The scene three hours later: the fate lines of these three assassins were twisted together like braids, their endpoint pointing to the same coordinates—the underground altar of the Imperial Capital. And deep within the altar, a vague figure sat cross-legged amidst black mist.

Why did the outline of that figure... look so familiar?

Meanwhile, the confrontation inside the quarters had already reached its climax.

The three assassins had backed Chen Nian into a corner, the Soul-Devouring Stab in the leader's hand less than three inches from her throat. "One last time, the Tianji Record—" Before he could finish, Chen Nian's gaze suddenly changed.

The trembling vanished.

Replacing it was a coldness and resolve that transcended her age.

"Brother, they have three "Xuanwu Tokens" on them." Her voice was clear and calm, "People of the Black Xuanwu."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian has already seen through the enemy's identity. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Continue feigning weakness, let them believe they've succeeded
choices.description: Have Chen Nian pretend to be defeated and captured, secretly track their return route, and follow the trail to uncover the lair of the mastermind behind the scenes.
choices.visible_cost: Must endure the risk of being stabbed
choices.visible_reward: May obtain intelligence on the Black Xuanwu's hideout location
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian's acting falters, she may expose more of her true strength

dialogue.content:
(A sweep of the short blade) You dare to be so reckless!

The Soul-Devouring Stab sliced through the air, striking directly toward Chen Nian's shoulder. Chen Nian stumbled backward, deliberately letting out a miserable cry, knocking over the vase behind her.

From behind the folding screen came Chen Ji's panicked voice: "Don't... don't kill her! The Tianji Record is yours!"

choices.text: Have Chen Nian strike directly, crushing them with thunderous force
choices.description: Tear away the disguise, have Chen Nian reveal her true strength, end the battle at the fastest speed, and intimidate the invaders.
choices.visible_cost: Completely expose Chen Nian's formation talent
choices.visible_reward: Instantly control the battlefield and obtain complete intelligence

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's gaze suddenly turned sharp as a blade. Her slender fingers traced a mysterious arc in the void, and the Spirit-Trapping Pendant at her waist burst into brilliant light. "Chen Family Spirit-Trapping Formation—Rise!" In an instant, golden formation patterns spread like a spider's web, firmly trapping the three assassins within. Their spiritual energy was drained like a receding tide, and the black miasma on the Soul-Devouring Thorns rapidly dissipated.

choices.text: Have Chen Nian pretend to be subdued while secretly activating the communication talisman.
choices.description: Deliberately show weakness to let the enemy think they have succeeded, while secretly notifying Tianqing Sect higher-ups, thereby testing whether there is a sect insider cooperating.
choices.visible_cost: Must let the enemy believe they have succeeded.
choices.visible_reward: Can test the loyalty within the sect.
choices.risk_hint: If there really is a sect insider, information may leak out.

dialogue.content: A flicker of understanding passed through Chen Nian's eyes. She allowed the Soul-Devouring Thorn to pierce her shoulder, blood spattering, letting out a shrill scream. At the same time, a communication talisman hidden in her sleeve quietly shattered, transmitting information silently outward. "Good," the lead assassin grinned savagely, "that's more like it."

text.content: No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the battle situation reversed in an instant. The three assassins were firmly trapped by the golden formation patterns, their spiritual energy flowing away like mud sinking into the sea, impossible to mobilize. The leader's face changed dramatically, his voice hoarse: "This... this is impossible! Youtrash—" "trash?" Chen Nian's voice was icy cold as the abyss springs of the Nine Netherworlds. "Is this all the见识 of your Black Xuanwu people?" She raised her hand, and a talisman shot out, sealing the lead assassin's mute穴. "Brother, shall we interrogate?"

Behind the folding screen, Chen Ji finally "slowly regained consciousness." He rubbed his drowsy eyes, stumbling to his feet, looking completely terrified. "Don't... don't kill me! I'll tell you everything!" However, when he "casually" glanced at the three people trapped by the formation, a faint cold light flickered in the depths of his pupils. He looked over each of their faces, as if recognizing something. After a moment, the corner of his mouth slightly lifted, revealing a meaningful smile. "Black Xuanwu assassins, truly well-trained." He spoke leisurely, his voice still trembling, "But... did your master ever tell you why they chose tonight to act?"

dialogue.content: (Eyes flickering, gritting teeth, refusing to speak)

text.content: Chen Ji "tremblingly" walked to the front of the formation, his gaze lingering on the three Xuanwu Tokens for a moment. "Each Black Xuanwu Token requires authorization with a blood seal at the Sect Master level." His voice gradually stopped trembling, replaced by a calmness that sent chills down spines. "In other words—the assassination tonight was personally ordered by the Xuanwu Sect Sect Master." The pupils of the three assassins constricted sharply. "But here's the problem..." Chen Ji tilted his head, with an expression between a smile and a sneer, "Han Lie, the publicly known Sect Master of Xuanwu Sect, has no knowledge of this. Right?"

choice.prompt: The interrogation has reached a critical point—how should Chen Ji continue to press for answers?

choices.text: Threaten with death to collapse the enemy's psychological defense.
choices.description: Directly inform the enemy of the formation's power—the Spirit-Trapping Formation will drain their spiritual energy within a quarter hour, after which their life and death will not be their own. Use a death countdown to force them to speak.
choices.risk_hint: The assassins may prefer death over confession.

text.content: Chen Ji sighed lightly, "In a quarter hour, you will become three dried corpses. Before that, if anyone is willing to speak, I might consider... leaving them alive." Silence. After a moment, the lead assassin suddenly grinned, his smile carrying inexplicable mockery and resolve. "You... think we... are afraid of death?" His voice was hoarse and eerie, "Black Xuanwu people... never fear death!"

choices.text: Use survival as a bargaining chip to exchange for critical intelligence.
choices.description: Tell them that as long as they reveal the mastermind, not only can they live, but they can also receive enough wealth to live in seclusion for the rest of their lives. Use the instinct for survival to shatter loyalty.
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may demand an excessively high price.

text.content: A cunning light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, "Whatever Black Xuanwu gave you, I will double. And... I can tell you one thing." He leaned down, whispering a few words into the lead assassin's ear. The assassin's pupils dilated sharply, an incredulous expression blooming on his face. "You... how do you know..."

choices.text: Drive a wedge between the three people, creating internal cracks.
choices.description: Tell one of them that the other two are already prepared to confess. Let them suspect each other, causing them to vie to speak first to protect themselves.

text.content:
Chen Ji "casually" glanced at the assassin on the left and sighed: "What a pity. You're clearly the most senior among the three, yet you've been assigned as bait."

The assassin shuddered all over, sharply turning his head to look at the other two.

"Is what he said true?" His voice turned sharp suddenly, "You want to sell me out?!"

The seed of discord had just been planted when the unexpected suddenly occurred.

The leading assassin's eyes flickered with determination, and a wisp of black blood trickled from the corner of his mouth. His body began to tremble violently, his pupils rapidly dilating.

"Not good!" Chen Nian exclaimed, "They've hidden poison capsules under their tongues!"

Chen Ji's expression slightly changed. Although he had anticipated that the Black Xuanwu's assassins would rather die than surrender, he hadn't expected them to be so resolute—not even leaving themselves a chance to speak.

Three streams of black blood simultaneously gushed from the corners of the three assassins' mouths, their bodies visibly withering, as if something was devouring them from within.

In just three breaths, the three corpses were already cold and rigid.

The assassins' expressions froze in that instant—not fear, not pain, but a strange... liberation.

Chen Nian hastily went forward to examine the body, pulling out a token and a secret letter from the leading assassin's chest.

The token was carved with a black crow spreading its wings—that was the信物 of the Black Xuanwu's Shadow Hall Hall Master.

The secret letter had been soaked with bloodstains, but several words could still be made out: "...Imperial Capital... underground... altar... within seven days..."

"Brother, the letter is destroyed," Chen Nian frowned, "But the token is real. The Black Xuanwu Shadow Hall Hall Master personally gave the order."

Chen Ji didn't answer. His gaze fell on the faces of the three corpses, carefully studying their expressions before death.

That expression... didn't look like despair of being driven to a dead end, but more like... serenity of having completed some kind of mission.

"Interesting," he murmured softly, "Assassins dying for their cause is nothing unusual. But to have such an expression before death... either they were brainwashed to the extreme, or..."

He paused, a cold light flashing in his eyes.

"Or they were controlled by extremely cruel means, living worse than death, and death was反而 a liberation."

choice.prompt: The three corpses have become dead ends in the clues. How should Chen Ji find the next breakthrough?

choices.text: Utilize the Tianji Record to trace the three people's fate trajectories
choices.description: Consume Heavenly Fate again to trace the source of the three people's lines of fate. The Tianji Record shows their fate endpoints point to the Imperial Capital underground altar. What is hidden there?
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is limited, cannot be misused

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes and sank his divine consciousness into the Tianji Record again.

Yellowed pages turned, and ancient vertical pupils emitted a deep, profound light. Three lines of fate rose from the three corpses, like three black threads, winding northward.

They passed through the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, skimmed over the continuous mountains, and finally converged at one point—the Imperial Capital.

At the deepest part of the Imperial Capital, a thousand zhang underground, there was an altar shrouded in black fog. On the altar sat a blurry human silhouette.

That silhouette's outline... why did it look so familiar?

choices.text: Start from the Shadow Hall Hall Master's token to investigate the Black Xuanwu's internal relationships
choices.description: This token is the Black Xuanwu Shadow Hall Hall Master's信物 and can become a lever to pry open the entire Shadow Hall. But the Shadow Hall's movements are secretive. How should one investigate?
choices.visible_cost: Need to take a risk and infiltrate the Xuanwu Sect
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the Shadow Hall's organizational structure
choices.risk_hint: The Xuanwu Sect may have more informants

text.content:
Chen Ji turned the token over and carefully examined the patterns on the back.

"This token was forged three years ago," he murmured to himself, "Each Black Xuanwu Shadow Hall token has a unique serial number and soul imprint..."

He bit his fingertip and dripped a drop of blood onto the token.

The blood seeped into the patterns, and刹那间, a faint soul fluctuation emerged from the token, pointing south—that was the direction of the Xuanwu Sect.

"Interesting," a cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "This token... was just used three days ago."

choices.text: Let Chen Nian use the Chen family's secret technique to examine the bodies, searching for hidden clues
choices.description: The Chen family's ancestral "Heavenly Fate Sensing Technique" can read fragmentary information from the fate traces remaining in the corpses. Although it doesn't consume Heavenly Fate, the reading may be incomplete.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the dying memories of the deceased

text.content:
Chen Nian nodded, sitting cross-legged beside the corpses with her hands forming complex mudras.

A faint silver light emanated from her palm, sinking into the brow center of the leading death warrior. After a moment, her brow furrowed tightly, her face turning pale.

"Brother... I saw a vision." Her voice trembled slightly, "An altar... a black altar... and a figure..."

"A figure?" Chen Ji pressed, "What did it look like?"

The vertical pupil of the Tianji Record contracted sharply.

Chen Ji's spiritual consciousness surged into the blurry scroll of destiny like a tide, analyzing frame by frame those fragmented visions.

The altar. A black altar stood deep underground, surrounded by countless dark runes, like some ancient evil formation. At the center of the altar sat a figure - the figure wore the robes of a Tianqing Sect Elder, with white hair and beard, a stern and rigid countenance.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently.

That was no one else.

It was Ling Yuan.

The former Patriarch of Tianqing Sect, the one who had been chosen by the Tianji Record for inheritance but ultimately was passed over. He had "entered seclusion" twenty years ago, supposedly long perished in some secret realm.

But now, he appeared alive atop the underground altar in the Imperial Capital, surrounded by black mist, like a demonic god descending.

And what made Chen Ji's heart even more chilled was - beside Ling Yuan stood another blurred figure. That figure was completely obscured by black mist, its features indistinguishable, yet the aura around it made Chen Ji feel an inexplicable sense of familiarity.

That aura... why was it so similar to the Tianji Record?

Chen Nian's face turned as pale as paper, the backlash of Heavenly Fate Divination causing her whole body to tremble.

"Brother... that person's aura..." her voice came in fragments, "is exactly the same as the Tianji Record..."

A cold light flickered across Chen Ji's eyes. He did not answer Chen Nian's question, but concentrated all his spiritual consciousness on that blurred figure.

The pages of the Tianji Record flipped wildly, the ancient vertical pupils blazing with unprecedented light. In that instant, he finally saw clearly the face hidden beneath the black mist -

It was a face he had never seen before, yet one that felt infinitely familiar.

Because that face... looked exactly like his own.

【Warning: Heavenly Fate Value Abnormal Fluctuation】
【Fate Rebound: Imminent Trigger】

Chen Ji猛地睁开眼睛，一口鲜血喷出。他的脸色瞬间苍白如纸，整个人摇摇欲坠。

"哥！"陈念惊呼着扑过来扶住他。

陈机摆了摆手，阻止她靠近。他的目光落在那三具icy的尸体上，眸中的shocked渐渐被一抹profound的寒意取代。

"有意思。"他whispered呢喃，嘴角勾起一抹sneered，"越来越有意思了。"

他slowly站起身，擦了擦嘴角的血迹，看向北方——那是皇都的方向。

"凌渊……天道之眼……还有那个'我'……"他的声音low而icy，"你们到底在下怎样一盘棋？"

Three corpses lay cold, yet the remnants of the death warriors' fate still echoed within the Tianji Record - a name that made Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply. The underground altar in the Imperial Capital, the cloaked figure, and a name that should never have appeared in this era: Ling Yuan.

The first assassination by the Black Xuanwu had ended in failure.

But Chen Ji knew this was merely the beginning.

Ling Yuan was not dead. He not only survived but established a mysterious altar beneath the Imperial Capital. And on that altar, besides Ling Yuan, stood another "Chen Ji."

What did this mean?

A projection from a parallel world? An incarnation of the Heavenly Eye? Or some temporal anomaly he had yet to comprehend?

Whatever the case, it indicated this chess game was far more complex than he had imagined.

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, tucking the Tianji Record back into his embrace. He gazed at the night sky beyond the window, his eyes gleaming with cold light.

"Since you want to play, I'll play along to the end."

His voice was low and icy, yet carried an unwavering resolve.

"But this time... it will be your turn to fall into my game."
